title: AZM-QOS: A Quantum Observable Simulation and QEC-Aware Research Workflow Platform
description: AZM-QOS is a Python-based research software platform for generalized quantum observable simulation workflows, QEC-aware logical estimators, hardware-result synchronization, reproducibility exports, and manuscript/thesis scaffolding.
notes: Synthetic and scaffold outputs are intended for workflow validation. Real hardware claims require imported or fetched Runtime job results and backend calibration metadata.
